clips.title: The story
paras: Feero Ironhand is a human paladin stationed at Maestra's Post in the western reaches of Ashenvale. Standing guard along the border between Darkshore and the forest, he works closely with Delgren the Purifier to combat the shadowy Cult of the Dark Strand.

Located along the road leading south from Darkshore into Ashenvale, Maestra's Post serves as a critical watchpoint for travelers and Alliance defenders alike. Feero Ironhand operates out of this outpost, maintaining communications and trade lines with Auberdine while keeping a vigilant watch over the surrounding woods. Together with Delgren the Purifier, Feero focuses his efforts against the malevolent Cult of the Dark Strand, ensuring the cultists and forest predators do not sever the path between Darnassus's supply lines and the front lines of Ashenvale.
